title: Topic 1.3: Self- Exploration and Career Development

pages.lesson:
LESSON: SELF- EXPLORATION AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.3: Self- Exploration and Career Development

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Self- Exploration and Career Development. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are talents and abilities nurtured?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain ways of nurturing talents and abilities for self- development

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SELF- EXPLORATION AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT
This lesson teaches Self- Exploration and Career Development for Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain ways of nurturing talents and abilities for self- development
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Self- Exploration and Career Development using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Self- Exploration and Career Development above.
2. Explain Self- Exploration and Career Development to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Self- Exploration and Career Development.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self- Exploration and Career Development with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Self- Exploration and Career Development important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are talents and abilities nurtured?
2. Why is self- exploration necessary for career development?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain ways of nurturing talents and abilities for self- development

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
